notes.title: Call of the Sea Patch 1.3
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

Patch 1.3 is now live. It's a small patch aiming to mainly fix a keybind issue that some of you were experiencing.

Please find the patch notes below, and please continue to share your feedback with us. We are actively listening and love to hear from you. Thank you and have fun in Call of the Sea!

[b]Menu & UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue that prevented access to game via keyboard when keys had been remapped by user prior to patch 1.2 (Please note that this fix will reset your previous keyboard rebind settings, and you will have to enter your customization again. We apologize for the inconvenience).
[*]Renamed “Hearing Impaired Subtitles” with “Closed Captions”.
[/list]
[b]Art & Visual FX[/b]
Removed Red Cross logo throughout the game.

Hey Everyone,  

We have been listening to your feedback and have implemented some changes in our latest patch. Please keep reporting any bugs you encounter. We have listed all the new changes in the patch notes below.

[b]General Gameplay[/b]
[list] [*] Fixed collision entering the in the rising platforms puzzle in Chapter 06
[*] Fixed wrong frequency in Journal, when pressing the 267 key
[*] Fixed bug when loading a save file created just after entering the tunnel to the drum puzzle in chapter 04
[*] Fixed User gets stuck when loading a manual save while choosing an ending in chapter 06
[*] Fixed missing element chapter 06 temple entrance
[*] Fixed visible landscape edge in chapter 06 temple hall
[*] Fixed seaweed inside rock / sand in chapter 06 temple pools [/list]

[b]Menu & UI[/b]
[list] [*] Fixed Epileptic warning label localization
[*] Split game menu settings on two, text language and accessibility.
[*] Added accessibility setting to display journal handwritten font.
[*] Added start screen after splash screens on PC platforms.
[*] Added load game, select chapter and exit game options in pause menu.
[*] Fixed D-pad response on user pop up confirmations.

[*] Fixed some audios FX on user interface.
[*] Fixed missed journal log entry on chapter 01 Bridge Puzzle.
[*] Fixed empty page journal navigation.

[*] Added gamepad button and a keyboard key to swap profile in main menu.

[list] [*] Removed Norah's gloves after the throne scene
[*] Added Dagon image to the Underwater City End
[*] Added plants to hide the Norah’s Inscription in the End’s White Beach version [/list]

[b]Voice & Narrative[/b]
[list] [*] Fixed Journal error in Spanish: the date of arrival in the Island corrected from 3 to 6 [/list]

notes.title: Tips & Tricks
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

As we are about to sign off for the holidays and enjoy some time off with our families, here are some tips and tricks we thought would come in handy:

[h2][u][b]Motion Sickness[/b][/u][/h2]

Our latest patch 1.1.105 on Steam adds many new features in the game options that will help with motion sickness in the rare case you would be affected by it.

To prevent Motion Sickness, we invite you to do the following:

[list]
[*] Don’t hide the crosshair

[*] Disable the smooth camera rotation

[*] Disable Motion Blur (now off by default with 1.1.105)
 
[*] Disable head bobbing
[/list]
Setup the FOV according to your distance to the screen:

[list]
[*] If you play on PC (less than 1m / 3.2 ft away): default FOV is 90º . Try to adjust it if you still get motion sickness.

[*] If you play on consoles (more than 2m / 6.4 ft away): default FOV is 75º. In the console version you cannot change the FOV settings, so move a bit farther from the screen.
[/list]

[h2][u][b]Miscellaneous[/b][/u][/h2]

[list]
[*] Player is unable to interact with objects or stuck in interaction screen
[/list]

Please turn Vertical Sync on, this should make this issue disappear. Pause the game, go to Options → Graphics → Vertical Sync ON.
[list]
[*] Player is unable to set 4K resolution
[/list]

This is a bug, but a work-around that should work for now is to go to Windows resolution settings. Set the zoom level to 100% or the normal value (not increased) and then start Call of the Sea, go to graphical settings and change to windowed mode, change to 4K resolution and the window should now be scaled up to 4K.
